info.syllabusName: Quản trị chuỗi cung ứng toàn cầu (Global Supply Chain Management)
info.description: This course provides an integrated view of managing supply chains in a global context. It equips students with practical tools and strategic frameworks to apply their interdisciplinary knowledge in designing and managing efficient, ethical, and sustainable global supply chains, while aligning with emerging industry trends and digital transformation.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Students will be able to analyze the evolution, roles, and future directions of supply chain management, distinguish it from logistics management, identify barriers and strategies to overcome them, and assess emerging models and structural transformations in the global supply chain landscape.

Students will be able to evaluate the strategic role of transportation in global supply chains by comparing various transport modes, understanding containerization and intermodal operations, assessing logistics service providers and outsourcing models, and applying trade facilitation tools such as Incoterms and compliance documentation.

Students will be able to apply concepts of inventory types, cost optimization, and planning tools such as forecasting, MRP, and S&OP, while analyzing the role of inventory and control systems in global supply chains and evaluating relevant technologies and emerging challenges.

Students will be able to assess outsourcing and offshoring strategies, analyze global procurement processes, evaluate supplier selection and performance, and understand key elements of contract negotiation and risk management in international supply chain partnerships.
